fine_trace.code: pdf_cache_object caches indirect object x and later frees it when refcount drops
fine_trace.note: The indirect object is cached and its lifetime is tied to the xref; a later resolution can free it while a chain still holds a pointer.

fine_trace.code: pdf_resolve_indirect calls pdf_resolve_indirect_chain to walk the indirect reference chain
fine_trace.note: Resolution walks the chain of indirect references, dereferencing cached objects.

fine_trace.code: pdf_resolve_indirect_chain dereferences obj after it may have been freed by a prior cache operation
fine_trace.note: Heap-use-after-free: the chain accesses/writes memory that has already been freed, leading to heap corruption.
